title: King of the Nether x Fresh Animations
description: Resource pack that makes the King of the Nether pack compatible with Fresh Animations by Fresh_LX!
body:
Compatibility pack to make [King of the Nether](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/king-of-the-nether) work with [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) by [Fresh_LX](https://modrinth.com/user/FreshLX)!



Requirements:

[EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)/[ETF]([https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/entity-texture-features-fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)) or [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/downloads)

[King of the Nether](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/king-of-the-nether)

[Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)



Load order:  
![King of the Nether x Fresh Animations > King of the Nether > FreshAnimations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85a8a1a52b46cea02f5cb6280ee895a7180e182e.png)
